newsitem.title: USA: Herley gets about $2 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Herley gets about $2 mln in contracts.

text.p: Herley Industries Inc said Monday that it received about $2 million in contracts from McDonnell Douglas Corp and Lockheed Martin Corp.
Herley, which makes flight instrumentation products for space launch vehicles, said the awards are the largest it has received to produce range safety transponders used in space launches.
Herley Industries consists of Herley Vega Systems in Lancaster, Pennsylvania; Herley-MDI in Woburn, Massachusetts; and Stewart Warner Electronics in Chicago.
